name: zoom-phone-mcp
description: Zoom Phone admin API for MSPs, plus E911, call routing, number and desk-phone audits across every client Zoom account.

zoom_phone_account_id.title: ZOOM_PHONE_ACCOUNT_ID
zoom_phone_account_id.description: Account ID of the Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth app (sent as account_id on the token request).

zoom_phone_client_id.title: ZOOM_PHONE_CLIENT_ID
zoom_phone_client_id.description: Client ID of the Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth app.

zoom_phone_client_secret.title: ZOOM_PHONE_CLIENT_SECRET
zoom_phone_client_secret.description: Client Secret of the Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth app.

zoom_phone_base_url.title: Zoom API base URL
zoom_phone_base_url.description: Base URL for the Zoom Phone API. Leave the prefilled default.

zoom_phone_token_url.title: OAuth token URL
zoom_phone_token_url.description: Token endpoint the Server-to-Server OAuth exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default.

zoom_phone_oauth_scope.title: OAuth scope (optional)
zoom_phone_oauth_scope.description: Optional. Leave blank: a Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth token carries the scopes added to the app.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. It does not select a Zoom account. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

zoom_phone_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
zoom_phone_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to refuse every write and every secret-returning read. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

zoom_phone_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
zoom_phone_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. The audits that read the local mirror then report nothing assessed. Leave blank to keep the local store.

zoom_phone_mcp_upload_root.title: MCP upload folder (optional)
zoom_phone_mcp_upload_root.description: Optional. A folder MCP file uploads (audio library files) may be read from by path. Leave blank: uploads then take base64 file content and the server reads no local path.

zoom_phone_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
zoom_phone_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Zoom requests. Leave blank to use the built-in User-Agent.

zoom_phone_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
zoom_phone_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.
